final: {"number": 998, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [2588, 2342, 2339], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java"], "reply": "Hi Shreyas, Mockito cannot stub a constructor call such as when(new URL(anyString())).thenReturn(u). The 'new' expression is not a method call on a mock, so there is nothing to stub. Mocking object construction is available since Mockito 3.5.0 with the inline mock maker (mockito-inline). Mockito 2.2.16 does not have it. Wrap the code in try (MockedConstruction<URL> mocked = mockConstruction(URL.class)) { ... } and stub the object created inside that block, as in the example in section 49, 'Mocking object construction', of the Mockito class Javadoc in org.mockito.Mockito."}
